create.name: Swamini Svatmavidyananda
create.bio:
Swamini Svatmavidyananda Saraswati is a teacher of Advaita Vedanta and Sanskrit in the Arsha Vidya lineage of Swami Dayananda Saraswati, whose disciple she is. She finished his three-year residential course in 2005 and then taught for many years in the United States, at Arsha Vidya Gurukulam in Saylorsburg and at Arsha Vijnana Gurukulam, her own teaching centre, which has groups in Georgia, Oregon and the San Francisco Bay Area. She has also taken part in international interfaith meetings on religious diversity and respect between traditions.

She now serves as a resident acharya at Swami Dayananda Ashram in Rishikesh, where she teaches on the ashram's short and long courses. Her daily classes there, held in person and streamed online, combine an early guided Vedantic meditation with line-by-line study of the Bhagavad Gita and the Upanishads with Shankara's commentary, and occasional question-and-answer satsangs. Her books include Overcoming Self-Sabotage in Self-Knowledge, Samvada: Dialogues on Oneness, Guided Meditation and Shraddhavan Labhate Jnanam. She also travels to lead retreats abroad, such as study retreats on the Bhagavad Gita in Mexico and talks on the Mandukya Upanishad at the Sivananda Ashram in the Bahamas.

books.title: Overcoming Self-Sabotage in Self-Knowledge: Insights from the Upanishads
books.author: Swamini Svatmavidyananda
books.description: Drawing on the Upanishads, she looks at the inner habits that keep a student from taking in the teaching of Vedanta, and at how self-knowledge itself loosens them.

courses.title: Christmas Retreat with Swamini Svatmavidyananda in the Huasteca Potosina
courses.description: A five-day residential retreat in the Huasteca Potosina region of Mexico on the twenty values the Bhagavad Gita lists as the means to knowledge, mixing teaching, reflection and silence. Hosted by Satyarupa Yoga.

courses.title: Being at Home with Om: Lessons from the Mandukya Upanishad
courses.description: A week of evening satsangs and workshops at the Sivananda Ashram Yoga Retreat in the Bahamas on the Mandukya Upanishad, its account of waking, dream and deep sleep, and the meaning of Om. Stays are booked through the ashram's yoga vacation programme.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditation | Advanced Vedantic Contemplation (30 Oct 2026)
free_resources.description: A recorded morning session from her daily classes in Rishikesh, guiding the listener through a contemplation on the self as taught in Vedanta.
